summary: Broad accounting.transactions scope replaced by granular scopes
details:
Xero split accounting.transactions into granular scopes (invoices, payments, bank transactions, manual journals, classic expenses, each with a .read variant). Apps created after 2026-03-02 must request granular scopes; existing apps keep the broad scopes until September 2027, and each connected user must re-authorize to receive the new ones.

Request the granular scopes in the authorization URL and have each connection re-authorize before the cutoff.
